description: Complete Firestore database schema for OrignaGTA e-commerce platform. Marketplace serving Canadian buyers, with sellers worldwide.

users.description: User accounts including buyers, sellers, and admins

lastCartAbandonEmailAt.description: Last time an abandoned-cart recovery email was sent to this user (TASK 10)

suspendedBy.description: Admin UID who suspended the account

lastRoleUpdateBy.description: Admin UID who last changed roles

emailConsent.description: User consented to receive transactional emails (CASL)

unsubscribedAt.description: When user unsubscribed from marketing emails (CASL audit trail)

privacyPolicyVersion.description: Version of privacy policy accepted by user

termsVersion.description: Version of terms of service accepted by user

dataProcessingConsent.description: Consent for data processing per PIPEDA

termsAcceptedAt.description: When terms of service were accepted

deleted.description: Whether user account has been deleted (GDPR)

anonymizedAt.description: When user data was anonymized after account deletion

originalUserDeleted.description: Flag on orders indicating the original user was deleted (GDPR)

notifyNewProducts.description: Opt-in: FCM notification for new products (premium only)

notifyTrending.description: Opt-in: FCM notification for trending products (premium only)

pushEnabled.description: User opted into push notifications — false means opt-out

fcmToken.description: FCM device token for push notifications

mfaEnrolledAt.description: When MFA was first enrolled (OK for display)

isSeller.description: Quick flag — seller details live in seller_profiles collection

addresses.description: User's address book for shipping and billing

isDefault.description: Whether this is the user's default address

notes: Users can have up to 10 addresses. One must be marked as isDefault=true.

createdAt.description: When item was added to cart

variantId.description: Variant ID if product has variants

priceSnapshot.description: Price in cents at time of cart addition

warehouses.description: Seller shipping locations (warehouses or personal/business addresses). One seller can have multiple warehouses across different cities or countries.

warehouseId.description: Auto-generated document ID, also stored as field for convenience

sellerId.description: Parent seller UID (mirrors the user document ID)

name.description: Human label, e.g. 'Toronto Warehouse' or 'Home Office'

address.description: Physical address for this shipping location

isDefault.description: Whether this is the seller's primary/default shipping location

indexes.description: Default warehouse first, then oldest first

notes: Only sellers have warehouses. Security rules allow read/write only to the owner (sellerId == request.auth.uid).
A seller may have 1–N warehouses across different cities or countries.
Products reference warehouse IDs via the warehouseIds array field.

indexes.description: For looking up users by Stripe Connect account

price.description: SELLING price in CAD (Canadian Dollars only). All prices on the platform are in CAD.

compareAtPrice.description: Original or MSRP price in CAD, must be greater than price. Used for strikethrough pricing display.

sellerSku.description: Seller-defined SKU. Unique per seller (sellerId + sellerSku). Used for deduplication — a product is rejected (isActive=false) if a duplicate sellerId+sellerSku already exists.

sellerAddress.description: Seller's manual shipping address. Mutually exclusive with warehouseIds — physical products must have either sellerAddress OR warehouseIds, not both.

warehouseIds.description: IDs of warehouses (from users/{sellerId}/warehouses) this product ships from. When set, overrides sellerAddress. Stock is tracked per-warehouse via warehouseStock.

shipFromCity.description: Denormalized city from the primary (first) warehouse. Set at write time by product_repository. Only present when warehouseIds is set.

shipFromProvince.description: Denormalized province/state from the primary warehouse.

shipFromCountry.description: Denormalized country from the primary warehouse.

shipFromCountries.description: Deduplicated list of all countries across all warehouseIds. Powers smart multi-country display on product cards: 1 country→'Ships from: City, Province, Country'; 2–3→'Ships from: Canada · Germany'; 4+→'Ships from: N locations worldwide'.

approvalRejectionReason.description: Admin rejection reason (set only when approvalStatus=rejected)

isDigital.description: True if product is digital (no shipping required). Examples: ebooks, software, courses

deliveryOptions.description: Seller-defined delivery options with quantity-based pricing

type.description: Delivery type: pickup, standard, express, same_day, custom

maxItemsPerShipment.description: Max items before cost increases (0 = no limit)

additionalItemCostCents.description: Additional cost in cents per item after maxItemsPerShipment

availableNationwide.description: Whether option is available for international suppliers

type.description: Supplier platform: aliexpress, alibaba, 1688, dhgate, temu, cjdropshipping, amazon_usa, custom, etc.

currency.description: Currency of SUPPLIER cost price (for cost tracking). Selling price is always CAD. Supported: CAD, USD, EUR, CNY, JPY, KRW, etc.

allowBackorder.description: Allow orders when out of stock

reservationHoldMinutes.description: How long to hold inventory during checkout

lastLowStockAlertAt.description: Last time a low-stock alert email was sent for this product. Written by check_low_stock_alerts cron. Used to enforce the 23-hour cooldown between alerts.

trendingScore.description: Computed trending score (views + purchases×3 + favorites×2 in last 48h)

hasVariants.description: Whether this product has variants (size, color, etc.). N-09.

variants.description: List of variant objects: {variantId, optionValues, price?, stockQuantity, sku?, isActive}. N-09.

subcategory.description: Optional subcategory within the main category. N-11.

condition.description: Product condition: new, like_new, good, fair, for_parts

priceCents.description: Price in integer cents — derived from price field at write time, used for all arithmetic (9.99 → 999)

inventoryLevels.description: Stock levels per warehouse for fast transaction processing.

availableQuantity.description: Current available stock for this warehouse

lastSyncedAt.description: When this inventory level was synced

indexes.description: For ID batch fetch with active filter

customerEmail.description: Customer email for notifications (optional, can be fetched from user doc)

sellerIds.description: Unique seller IDs in this order (computed from items)

productIds.description: Unique product IDs in this order (computed from items, enables chat gate query)

subtotalCents.description: Sum of item prices in cents (prevents rounding errors)

taxes.description: Tax breakdown (GST, PST, HST, QST) - for display only

totalAmountCents.description: Grand total in cents (subtotal + taxes + shipping)

currency.description: Currency code (always 'cad' — all transactions in CAD)

createdAt.description: Order creation timestamp (used by Flutter queries)

confirmedByClient.description: Buyer confirmed receipt of all items

confirmedAt.description: When order was confirmed by buyer

autoConfirmed.description: Whether confirmation was automatic after 5 days

autoCaptured.description: Whether payment was auto-captured by cron job

shippingApprovalRequired.description: Whether shipping cost approval is required from buyer

actualShippingCents.description: Actual shipping cost set by seller (for approval flow)

stockRestored.description: Whether stock was restored after cancellation

cancelledBy.description: Who cancelled the order (buyer, seller, system, admin)

disputeId.description: Stripe dispute ID if order is disputed

preDisputeStatus.description: Order status before dispute was filed (for restoration on dispute won)

requiresManualReview.description: Whether order requires manual admin review

taxExempt.description: Whether order is tax exempt (B2B reverse charge applied)

couponCode.description: N-07: Promo/coupon code applied to this order

discountAmountCents.description: N-07: Discount applied in cents (from coupon)

schemaVersion.description: Schema layout version for migration tracking

indexes.description: For buyer's order history (Flutter uses createdAt)

events.description: Immutable event log for order lifecycle transitions

metadata.description: Additional context (e.g. refund amount, tracking number)

amountCents.description: Total seller revenue before platform fee (in cents)

netAmountCents.description: Net payout to seller after fee (in cents)

partialReversals.description: List of partial reversals for per-item refunds

disputeId.description: Stripe Dispute ID (if reversed due to dispute)

autoCaptured.description: Whether payout was created by auto-capture cron

livemode.description: Whether event is from live mode

security_alerts.description: Security alert records for suspicious activity, payment issues, and system health

idempotencyKey.description: Client-generated idempotency key to prevent duplicate order creation

errorCode.description: Error code from Stripe or other service

rate_limits.description: Rate limiting records for API protection. Cleaned up by cleanup_stale_rate_limits cron every 30 min.

last_request.description: Most recent request in window (used by cleanup cron)

reviewImageUrls.description: Optional review photo URLs (max 3, must be CDN hosted)

helpfulCount.description: N-04: Number of users who found this review helpful

helpfulVoterIds.description: DEPRECATED: Do not use. Votes are tracked in review_votes/{voterId} subcollection (product_ratings/{ratingId}/review_votes/{userId}) to avoid unbounded array growth. This field is kept for schema backward-compat only.

sellerReply.description: N-03: Seller reply to this review

verifiedPurchase.description: True when the reviewer has a confirmed delivered order for this product

coupons.description: N-07: Coupon/promo code system. Document ID = coupon code (uppercase)

couponCode.description: Coupon code (document ID, uppercase, 4-20 alphanumeric chars)

minOrderCents.description: Minimum cart subtotal in cents required to use this coupon

maxUsesTotal.description: Maximum total uses across all users (null = unlimited)

usedCount.description: Total number of times this coupon has been redeemed

isActive.description: Whether the coupon is currently active

sellerId.description: Seller ID if this is a seller-specific coupon (null = platform-wide)

createdByAdminId.description: Admin UID who created this coupon

coupon_uses.description: Per-user coupon usage tracking. Document ID = userId. Replaces unbounded usedByUids array.

useCount.description: Number of times this user has redeemed the coupon

email.description: Buyer email at time of subscription

notifiedAt.description: When notification email was sent (null = not yet notified)

askerId.description: User ID of the buyer who asked

answeredBy.description: UID of whoever answered (seller or admin)

isAnswered.description: Whether the question has been answered

seller_metrics.description: Weekly seller performance metrics (TASK 11). Document ID = sellerId.

lateShipmentRate.description: Late shipment rate (0.0–1.0) over last 30 days

avgResponseTimeHours.description: Average hours to first response on buyer messages (30-day avg)

totalOrders30d.description: Total orders in the last 30 days

totalRevenueCents30d.description: Seller's gross revenue (integer, 100 = $1.00 CAD) in the last 30 days

computedAt.description: When these metrics were last computed

avgShipDays.description: Average days from order confirmed to shipped (30-day avg). Null for new sellers.

positiveRatePct.description: Percentage of ratings that are 4 or 5 stars (0–100). Null for new sellers.

totalReviews.description: Total number of reviews the seller has received across all products

_cron_locks.description: Distributed locks for cron jobs to prevent concurrent execution across Cloud Function instances

lockedBy.description: Identifier of the instance holding the lock (cron_{jobName})

completedAt.description: When the job finished and released the lock

algolia_sync_failures.description: Dead Letter Queue for failed Algolia sync operations, retried hourly up to max retries

productId.description: Product ID that failed to sync

resolved.description: Whether the failure has been resolved (retried or max retries exceeded)

maxRetriesExceeded.description: True if retry limit reached without success

lastRetryError.description: Error type from most recent retry attempt

createdAt.description: When the failure was first recorded

subscriptions.description: Premium subscription records — one per user. Authoritative source for isPremium status. Written by backend on Stripe webhook.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID (same as document ID)

currentPeriodEnd.description: End of current billing period (premium expires after this)

cancelAtPeriodEnd.description: Whether subscription cancels at end of current period

cancelScheduledAt.description: When cancellation was requested to take effect at period end

subscriptions.security: User reads own. Backend-only writes (Stripe webhooks).

chats.description: Product-scoped buyer↔seller chat threads. Premium buyers only. One thread per buyer+product combination.
chats.security: Buyer and seller of the thread can read/write. Backend creates threads.

user_security.description: Backend-only MFA secrets — Firestore rules: allow read, write: if false. Only accessible via Admin SDK.

mfaBackupCodesTemp.description: Temporary hashed backup codes during enrollment

mfaFailedAttempts.description: Count of consecutive failed MFA attempts

mfaLockoutUntil.description: Lockout expiry after max failed attempts

seller_profiles.description: Seller-specific profile data — split from users doc. Buyers never load this doc.

pendingRequirements.description: Stripe Connect pending verification requirements (seller only)

returnWindowDays.description: Days buyer has to initiate a return

payoutHoldDays.description: Days to hold payouts after delivery

return_requests.description: Tracks physical return requests with state machine: requested → approved → label_issued → received → refunded | rejected | escalated

orderItemId.description: Cart item ID of the item being returned

resolvedAt.description: When return was resolved (refunded or rejected)

escalatedAt.description: When the return was escalated to admin

address.description: Nested address object: {street, city, state (2-letter province), postalCode, country, latitude?, longitude?}

seller_skus.description: Atomic SKU collision docs — top-level: seller_skus/{sellerId}_{sku}

book_access_tokens.description: Temporary access tokens for digital book downloads

software_access_tokens.description: Temporary access tokens for software download links

pending_profiles.description: Pending seller onboarding profiles awaiting Stripe Connect completion

fcm_tokens.description: FCM device push tokens — subcollection: users/{uid}/fcm_tokens/{tokenId}

email_logs.description: Sent email audit log for CASL/PIPEDA compliance

Address.description: Address object used throughout the app

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default address

name.description: Product name at time of order

price.description: Price per unit at time of order

trackingNumber.description: Shipping tracking number for this item

carrier.description: Shipping carrier: ups, fedex, canada_post, purolator, dhl, usps, other

refundAmountCents.description: Partial refund amount in cents (item + proportional tax/shipping)

confirmedByBuyer.description: Buyer confirmed receipt of this item

variantId.description: Variant ID at time of purchase

variantTitle.description: Human-readable variant label e.g. 'Size: M / Color: Blue'

variantSku.description: Variant SKU snapshotted at purchase time

isDigital.description: Whether this item is a digital product

supplier.description: Supplier info for international shipping estimates

fulfillmentWarehouseId.description: Warehouse ID from which this item was fulfilled (null if seller ships from address)

carrierNote.description: Free-text carrier override when carrier='other' (max 500 chars)

sellerSku.description: Seller's SKU snapshotted at purchase time

sellerName.description: Seller display name snapshotted at purchase time (Shopify/Amazon pattern)

SellerPayout.description: Payout breakdown for a single seller. All money in integer cents.

amountCents.description: Gross amount in cents before platform fee

netAmountCents.description: Net amount seller receives in cents

values.in_transit: Carrier has the package in transit

platformFee.description: Platform fee charged on seller payouts

autoConfirmDays.description: Days after delivery before auto-confirming order

geographicRestrictions.description: Marketplace serving Canadian buyers. Sellers can be from any country. Buyers must have Canadian billing/shipping addresses.

shippingCalculation.description: Shipping cost based on distance from seller

taxes.description: Provincial tax rates applied based on delivery address

supplierPlatforms.description: Supported international supplier platforms for dropshipping
